title: Tree centres its row content, so a wrapping label misaligns the leaf icon
foundBy: an agent building a documentation browser against 0.2.0, relayed by the repository owner
details:
Tree rows are laid out with `align-items: center`, and there is no prop to change it. A `renderLabel` that returns two lines, such as a filename above a description, leaves the leaf icon floating at the vertical middle of the row instead of sitting on the first line. The reporter measured the icon centre at 131px against a first-line centre of 123px.

Centring is right for the single-line labels Tree anticipates. It is wrong the moment `renderLabel` wraps, and `renderLabel` is a public prop, so wrapping is a supported input.

The proposal is `alignLabel` taking `center` or `start`, defaulting to `center`, or aligning to the first line automatically when the label wraps.

Worked around in the consuming app with a CSS override on the generated class name.

notes.text: Confirmed: align-items center at src/styles/components/tree.css:136, and TreeProps carries no alignment prop.
